description: Add a top-level page item to an existing group (the group is rebuilt: it keeps its name but gets a new ID and index)

groupIndex.description: Index of the group to add the item to, as numbered by list_groups (its index in page.allPageItems)

itemIndex.description: Index of the page item to add to the group, in page.allPageItems as numbered by list_page_items (nested items included)

pageIndex.description: Index of the page containing the group and item (0-based)

name: add_item_to_group
title: Add Item To Group
